level_c_model.velocity_authority: provider vx/vy first; otherwise same-entity first difference only within max_velocity_gap_s; zero fallback is explicit

B.input_contract: canonical tracking positions plus declared pitch boundary

C.input_contract: canonical positions plus versioned kinematic assumptions

D.input_contract: source event rows plus explicitly synchronized tracking

E.input_contract: temporally stable team tracking and a versioned shape/phase model

global_method_contract.coordinate_frame: Every output cites the input coordinate_frame_id; no implicit axis swap or origin conversion is allowed.
global_method_contract.attacking_direction: Attack-normalized quantities require a declared per-team direction. If unavailable, frame-axis quantities may be served only with frame-axis labels.
global_method_contract.player_policy: Include finite player and goalkeeper rows. Goalkeepers are not silently excluded. Outfield-only metrics require an explicit identity authority.
global_method_contract.time_policy: Group only exact canonical t_rel_ns values. Do not interpolate across gaps or silently merge periods.
global_method_contract.missing_policy: Missing coordinates are absent from the frame calculation and quality records state the missing count. Extrapolated/source-model rows are retained with input quality provenance unless a processor parameter explicitly excludes them.
global_method_contract.units: SI units; ratios and proportions use unit 1.

metrics.name: Team centroid X
metrics.definition: Arithmetic mean of finite included player x_m at one canonical timestamp.

metrics.name: Team centroid Y
metrics.definition: Arithmetic mean of finite included player y_m at one canonical timestamp.

metrics.name: Team length
metrics.definition: max(x_m) - min(x_m) in the declared frame; not attack-normalized unless direction is declared.

metrics.name: Team width
metrics.definition: max(y_m) - min(y_m) in the declared frame.

metrics.name: Team length:width ratio
metrics.definition: length / width; unavailable when width is zero.

metrics.name: Team convex-hull occupied area
metrics.definition: Area of the convex hull of included player positions; fewer than three non-collinear points produce zero area.

metrics.name: Team stretch index
metrics.definition: Root-mean-square player distance from the team centroid divided by pitch diagonal; pitch dimensions are parameters.

metrics.name: Mean pairwise teammate distance
metrics.definition: Mean of all unordered included-player pair distances.

metrics.name: Minimum pairwise teammate distance
metrics.definition: Minimum unordered included-player pair distance.

metrics.name: Maximum pairwise teammate distance
metrics.definition: Maximum unordered included-player pair distance.

metrics.name: Nearest teammate distance
metrics.definition: Minimum Euclidean distance to another included player in the same declared group.

metrics.name: Nearest opponent distance
metrics.definition: Minimum Euclidean distance to an included player in another declared group.

metrics.name: Inter-team centroid distance
metrics.definition: Euclidean distance between two declared team centroids.

metrics.name: Distance to team centroid
metrics.definition: Euclidean distance from one player to its declared team centroid.

metrics.name: Ball-to-team-centroid distance
metrics.definition: Euclidean distance from the finite ball row to each team centroid; no possession is inferred.

metrics.name: Longitudinal expansion rate
metrics.definition: First finite difference of frame-axis team length over adjacent canonical timestamps within one continuous stream.

metrics.name: Lateral expansion rate
metrics.definition: First finite difference of frame-axis team width over adjacent canonical timestamps within one continuous stream.

metrics.name: Clipped player Voronoi area
metrics.definition: Player nearest-point cell clipped to the declared rectangular pitch boundary.

metrics.name: Team Voronoi-controlled area
metrics.definition: Sum of clipped player cells for one declared team.

metrics.name: Team Voronoi control percentage
metrics.definition: Team controlled area / pitch area * 100; this is geometric territory, not possession probability.

metrics.name: Team frame-third controlled area
metrics.definition: Clipped player-cell area intersected with one equal-width frame-axis x third; not attacking thirds.

metrics.name: Player time-to-arrival field
metrics.definition: Declared kinematic travel-time estimate from current position to a bounded grid cell.

metrics.name: Team dominant influence percentage
metrics.definition: Percentage of bounded grid cells whose minimum declared arrival time belongs to the team.

metrics.name: Selected-player influence area
metrics.definition: Area of bounded cells for which the selected player has the minimum declared arrival time.

metrics.name: Opponent minimum arrival time
metrics.definition: Minimum declared arrival time from an opponent to a selected location.

metrics.name: Source event tracking snapshot
metrics.definition: Chronological source event identity/context joined to the nearest synchronized tracking frame; never relabelled as a new event class.

metrics.name: Team shape window
metrics.definition: Reserved until a temporal shape model, stable-window rule and source capability gate pass.
